sealed_record.thesis: CASHCAT/CATE (cash-cat native) ran to $220m+ on pure listing anticipation, then round-tripped to ~$100m after Robinhood actually delivered the listing — a heavily front-run CEX debut on an exchange that rarely lists memes. Multiple accounts (zinceth, solstice, 0xIT4I) converge that the post-listing dump is overdone, insider/front-running complaints are surfacing (a potential re-rate catalyst), and a funding long-squeeze is unwinding on the perp. The bet is that RH-listed liquidity plus the insider controversy re-attracts flow and pushes native back toward and beyond prior highs. Pure meme/attention play — exit into hype, not fundamentals.
